# PumpApi Documentation

> The fastest & simplest API for Pump.fun, Raydium and Meteora & Solana and token transfers

- [Pump.fun API for Trading Bots](/index.md): Pump.fun API, PumpSwap, Raydium, and Meteora. Trade tokens, stream real-time data, historical replay, create tokens, and send Jito bundles.


## Actions

- [Actions](/actions.md): Execute multiple swap operations in a single transaction using Actions.

## Burn

- [🔥 Burn Tokens – API](/burn.md): Use this endpoint to permanently remove tokens from circulation.

## Claim Cashback

- [Claim Cashback – pump.fun API](/claim-cashback.md): Automatic cashback withdraw from pump.fun and PumpSwap.

- [Create Token | Raydium API](/create-token-raydium-launchpad.md): Launch tokens & launchpads on Raydium Launchpad using a single API request.

## Get Balances

- [Get Balances – Solana API](/get-balances.md): Fetch SOL balance and all SPL token balances of a wallet in a single request.

- [Get Token Info – API](/get-token-info.md): API to get info about pump.fun, raydium and meteora pools

## Historical Replay

- [Historical Replay](/historical-replay.md): Download hourly snapshots of our Data Stream for backtesting, research, and replay simulations. Fast zst-compressed archives, ~400 MB per hour.

## Jito Bundles

- [Jito Bundles](/jito-bundles.md): Send up to 5 transactions in a single atomic bundle using Jito. Fastest & simplest pump.fun API !
